title: Use case 1 — Static browse dashboard
prompt: Build a static ops dashboard with two browse screens: (1) Incidents — table with severity, status, and owner, plus header metrics for open count and resolved today; (2) Teams — table with team name, lead, headcount, and region. Use data.mode static with realistic invented sample records (about 3 incidents and 3 teams). No API wiring. Validate and save when the spec passes.

conversationScript.content: Two separate browse screens: Incidents and Teams. Static invented data only — no API endpoints.
